select ie.space_id, ie.activity_id, count(*)::integer as event_count from interaction_events ie
join household_members hm on hm.account_id = ie.account_id join households h on h.household_id = hm.household_id where hm.household_id = #{householdId} and hm.status = 'active' and h.status = 'active'
where ie.account_id = #{ownerAccountId}
and ie.client_timestamp >= #{weekStart,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler} and ie.client_timestamp <= #{now,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler} group by ie.space_id, ie.activity_id order by count(*) desc, ie.space_id asc, ie.activity_id asc limit 5
